claims.claim: A draft DHS inspector general report says the administration graduated thousands of new ICE officers through a training regimen one instructor called a catastrophic failure.
claims.source_title: Leaked Draft Report Finds ‘Catastrophic’ Training Failures at ICE
claims.supporting_quote: The Trump administration graduated thousands of new ICE officers through a training regiment that one instructor called a “catastrophic failure,” according to a draft copy of a Department of Homeland Security inspector general’s report obtained by the Times.

claims.claim: President Trump signed Executive Order 14438 on November 20 requiring federal contractors to notify the White House before answering Congress and to withhold material the White House deems protected by executive privilege.
claims.episode_span: Executive Order 14438, was signed on 20 November
claims.source_title: Contractors Must Tell White House First: Trump Signs Order On Congressional Requests
claims.supporting_quote: The order, Executive Order 14438, was signed on 20 November. Under it, contractors must “NOTIFY FIRST”, informing the White House and their contracting agencies about relevant requests from Congress, and must follow “WITHHOLDING INSTRUCTIONS” for communications deemed protected by executive privilege.

claims.claim: Noncompliance with the contractor order could trigger termination, debarment or suspension, and implementation is subject to applicable law and available appropriations.
claims.episode_span: termination of the contract, debarment or suspension
claims.source_title: Contractors Must Tell White House First: Trump Signs Order On Congressional Requests
claims.supporting_quote: Noncompliance could trigger termination of the contract, debarment or suspension. Implementation remains subject to applicable law and available appropriations, which is the order’s own acknowledgement that it cannot override statutes or the Constitution.
